g.text: Three Trust Domains · Constant-Latency Webhook Ingress · Deterministic-First Review Pipeline
Raw unified diffs · changed file bodies · title
Treated strictly as data, never as control instructions
Must pass Zod schema re-validation + anchor check
Idempotent on event_id · client claims inert
Dashboard access via Next.js web application
• Webhook receiver: signature verify + delivery dedup (< 300 ms)
• Enqueues jobs to Redis — NEVER runs pipeline or calls LLM
• Tenant-scoped REST API for dashboard UI with RBAC capability guard
• Auth service (Argon2id + session hash), rate limits, health probes
ISOLATION INVARIANT: NO LLM CALLS ON API HOT PATH (DoS DEFENSE)
• review-queue: payload carries only jobId pointer (never authz state)
• Distributed in-flight locks (SET NX) · Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) · Backpressure
• Loads durable state from Postgres · Enforces plan quota & same-SHA gates
• Wall-clock budget (240s) · Degrades to partial results if budget exceeded
1. Pre-flight quota & same-SHA check → 2. Bounded diff parse (diff-engine)
4. Task-routed AI (Triage → Deep Review → Security Pass)
5. Line anchor resolution → Dedup → Confidence Floor (0.6) → Summary
✓ Persist-then-Publish: findings & usage saved in DB before GitHub review call

svg.text: ▲ Multi-Tenant Isolation: Every query scoped by org_id; cross-tenant yields 404

g.text: Fetch PR diff (bounded: max 60 files / 3k lines)
Publish verdict summary + validated inline comments
ESLint + Semgrep security & logic AST scanning
Zero LLM cost · exempt from confidence floor
Tenant BYOK keys encrypted with AES-256-GCM
Pino JSON structured logs with secret redaction
Trace correlation by review jobId across worker

svg.text: ▲ Zero Plaintext Secrets: Masking gates on all logs
